api.formatter: src/tui/duration-format.ts exports formatDuration(ms: number): string. Round to tenths first (Math.round(ms/100)), then split: <60s '58.3s' (always one decimal, 's' suffix), <1h 'M:SS.t' ('12:04.5', minutes without leading zero), >=1h 'H:MM:SS.t'. 59_950 -> '1:00.0'; 3_599_950 -> '1:00:00.0'; NaN/negative -> em dash. subagent-session.formatElapsed must return exactly formatDuration(ms) (tested for equality).
api.chrome: ShellChrome gains setBusyFooter(info | undefined) with info = { tokensIn?, tokensOut?, costUsd?, contextPct?, queued?, backgroundJobs?, subagents? }. It repaints at once, is ignored when idle, and is cleared by stopBusy. costUsd is passed only when the price is known.
api.busy_painting: paintBusyStatus writes the spinner/phase/timer only to liveStatus (the in-transcript line, placed above the composer). footer-left shows, joined by ' · ' and dropped whole from the end: (1) 'Esc interrupt · Enter queue · / commands', (2) '↑<in> ↓<out>' + ' $<cost>' when costUsd is given (K suffix at >= 1000, e.g. '↑1.2K'; cost like '$0.5'), (3) 'ctx <pct>%', (4) 'queue <n>', 'jobs <n>', 'agents <n>' only when non-zero. footer-right keeps 'mode <permission>' else status. Footer never exceeds the terminal width; 'Esc interrupt' and the right slot survive at every width from 220 down to 60.
api.background_jobs: formatJobMeta (background-job-session.ts, used by the inspector Meta tab) gains a 'Duration' row: endedAt - startedAt when ended, else now - startedAt, via formatDuration. startedAt/endedAt are ISO strings.
api.worked_for: tui-shell.ts 'worked for' (two sites near 9870 and 10097) is not asserted: it is reachable only through the launcher, which cannot run headless. The implementer must route both through formatDuration; consider a small exported helper if a test is wanted. Same for the tui-shell busy-phase state around 4277-4290: keep it from painting its own timer.

assumptions: The footer row is the last rendered row and the sidebar sits to its right (the row ends with the sidebar border), so width fitting is measured on that row.
Date.now is the clock the busy timer reads (busyStartedAt = Date.now()); the tests mock it with spyOn.
Negative or non-finite durations print an em dash (kept from the old formatElapsed).
Background jobs currently print no duration at all; AC21 'background jobs' is read as: show one, in the compact format.
